r: Web portal (with Bhuseva) launched by CM N. Chandrababu Naidu on **20 Nov 2018**; every land parcel gets an **11-digit unique number**; people **view land records online**
Began **11 April 2018** in Jaggaiahpeta and Vuyyuru (Krishna district)
Earlier portal (13 June 2015) to view Adangal / 1-B records and check the **authenticity of land documents**
Computerisation of land records, united AP, **1992**; pilot **Nizamabad**
Computer-aided registration: **anywhere registration, auto-mutation**, at Grama Sachivalayams – a registration system
Issued by the **Sub-Registrar's (Registration) office** where the property documents are registered; shows the charges / transactions on a property
AP proposed a **Survey Assistant** in each village secretariat for **100% verification of land records**; post filled in 2019 as **Village Surveyor (Grade-III)**
**Resurvey** (Jagananna Saswatha Bhu Hakku and Bhu Raksha)
From **December 2020**: drones, CORS, GIS; **6,901 villages, 81 lakh parcels**
Carry the **State emblem**; 36 lakh issued, 56 lakh more by March 2027
Grades States on **digitisation and quality of land records**: AP **10th (2020) → 6th (2021)**; **Madhya Pradesh** topped
First to computerise **RTCs** (Records of Rights, Tenancy and Crops)
**Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas**
**Drones + CORS** (Continuously Operating Reference Stations) – an integrated **property validation solution for rural India**
**Abadi (inhabited village) areas only** – not agricultural land
**Property Cards** (Records of Rights, also in DigiLocker): **3.06 crore** in 1.86 lakh villages (Jan 2026; earlier 2.76 crore)
6.62 lakh villages; drone survey done in **3.28 lakh** of 3.44 lakh notified villages (Dec 2025)

**NLRMP in 2008** = merger of **CLR** (Computerisation of Land Records) + **SRA&ULR** (Strengthening of Revenue Administration and Updating of Land Records); renamed **Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme**
**Central Sector, 100% central funding** from **1 April 2016** (earlier centrally sponsored)
To **2025-26** with two new components – **consent-based Aadhaar seeding** and **computerisation of revenue courts**; mandatory **gender column** in the RoR
Modern record rooms, survey / resurvey, **digitised cadastral maps**, computerised registration, State data centre (abadi Property Cards belong to **SVAMITVA**)
**14-digit alphanumeric** parcel ID from the **geo-coordinates of the parcel's vertices**; 36.67 crore parcels
"**One Nation One Registration Software**" – common, configurable registration application for sub-registrars and citizens
Cloud GIS; a **Bhu-Aadhaar** for every parcel
Registration only **records a transaction**; title can be challenged
**State guarantees the title**; cannot be disputed once issued
Registration, survey and revenue records kept separately
**NITI Aayog Model Conclusive Land Titling Act, 2020**
**Registration of a transfer deed is distinct from title**
Presumptive → **conclusive**, State as guarantor; criticised for limiting disputes to the **High Court**; **repealed 2024**
